CREATE TABLE EDS.RIB_USERENROLMENT
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CUST_ID)
)
AS
SELECT ACCT_CATEGORY
	, ACCT_TYPE
	, ACID
	, BACKEND_SYSTEM
	, BANK_ID
	, BRANCH
	, CR_FLG
	, CUST_ID
	, DB_TS
	, DEL_FLG
	, R_CRE_ID
	, R_CRE_TIME
	, R_MOD_ID
	, R_MOD_TIME
	, USER_DEFINED_FIELD_1
	, USER_DEFINED_FIELD_2
	, USER_DEFINED_FIELD_3
	, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, INSERT_DTTM

FROM
(
	SELECT ACCT_CATEGORY
		, ACCT_TYPE
		, ACID
		, BACKEND_SYSTEM
		, BANK_ID
		, BRANCH
		, CR_FLG
		, CUST_ID

		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID, CUST_ID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT ACCT_CATEGORY
			, ACCT_TYPE
			, ACID
			, BACKEND_SYSTEM
			, BANK_ID
			, BRANCH
			, CR_FLG
			, CUST_ID

				over( partition by ACCT_CATEGORY
						, ACCT_TYPE
						, ACID
						, BACKEND_SYSTEM
						, BANK_ID
						, BRANCH
